name: tv-vigil
description: Android TV background app watchdog — auto-kills rogue apps lingering in background without root. Deploys via ADB, survives reboots with watchdog.

prerequisites.always_on_host: optional, for watchdog persistence across TV reboots

vigil.sh.description: Management CLI for the appkiller daemon

status.description: Full system state: daemon, stats, script presence
status.json_output: {connected, daemon, pid, uptime_min, total_cycles, total_kills, total_skips, script_installed}

log.description: Show recent log entries from the daemon

stats.description: Show kill statistics with per-app breakdown

start.description: Push appkiller.sh to TV and start the daemon

flags.--json: Output structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable text

exit_codes.3: daemon not running or no stats (informational)

setup.sh.description: One-command initial deployment: push appkiller to TV, start daemon, optionally install watchdog crontab

exit_codes.1: failure (adb not found, cannot connect, or daemon failed to start)

watchdog.sh.description: Keepalive script for always-on hosts — checks if appkiller is running on TV, restarts if not
watchdog.sh.note: Config is hardcoded at top of file (ADB path, TV_IP). Designed for crontab.

exit_codes.0: daemon already running or successfully restarted

appkiller.sh.description: The daemon itself — runs ON the Android TV, not on the host. Managed via vigil.sh or setup.sh.
appkiller.sh.note: Do not run directly from host. Use vigil.sh start instead.

THRESHOLD.description: Seconds an app must be in background before being killed

ROGUE_APPS.description: Newline-separated list of package names to monitor
